subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A class group chat became messy.”?
options: The class created rules: homework questions before 9 p.m., no personal attacks, announcements pinned, and separate chats for games.
The class created a rule: AI could help with learning, but students had to check facts and write final answers themselves.
Students added basketball games, music practice, library days, and reminders to water the class plant.
Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The class created rules: homework questions before 9 p.m., no personal attacks, announcements pinned, and separate chats for games.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The class created a rule: AI could help with learning, but students had to check facts and write…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students added basketball games, music practice, library days, and reminders to water the class plant.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The class created rules: homework questions before 9 p.m., no personal attacks, announcements pinned, and separate chats for games.」，答案為「The class created rules: homework questions before 9 p.m., no personal attacks, announcements pinned, and separate chats for…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The class created rules: homework questions before 9 p.m., no personal attacks, announcements pinned, and separate chats for…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
